probes.question: About what percentage of viewers missed the gorilla in the famous attention experiment?

image.alt: Basketball, 1. Damen-Basketball-Bundesliga, ChemCats Chemnitz; Abigail Asoro (9)

body.question: Viewers counted basketball passes in a video. What percentage failed to notice a person in a gorilla suit walking through?
body.reveal: About half of viewers missed the gorilla. Focusing hard on one task can hide even something obvious. This is called inattentional blindness.
